Hello! I am Muhsin. I am an economist and I received my PhD in economics from Goethe University Frankfurt, Germany. My research focuses on macroeconometrics, inflation, central banking and climate change. *tidyMacro* grew out of the tools I used in my work.

I wrote the package for my own research and share it freely, in the hope that it saves others some time.
